paper.title_en: Cosmic Overture Echoed in a Stellar Final Act: Implications of Nanohertz Gravitational Waves for Core Collapse Supernova Neutrinos
paper.abstract_en: The growing evidence for nanohertz gravitational waves, from NANOGrav and other observations, may be pointing to a cosmological first-order phase transition at temperatures of $\mathcal{O}(10-100)\;\mathrm{MeV}$. Such an interpretation requires beyond the Standard Model dynamics in this energy range. If so, it may well be the case that galactic core-collapse supernova explosions would produce the key components related to the first-order phase transition, leaving detectable imprints on the spectrum of neutrinos emitted in the initial few seconds of the collapse. This might provide further evidence in support of the early universe interpretation of the nanohertz gravitational wave signal. The scenario proposed here is also suggestive of a low-mass seesaw mechanism to explain neutrino masses. We outline the prospects for future observations of Galactic supernovae to uncover the signals of this scenario, with further confirmation from future pulsar timing array measurements of primordial nanohertz gravitational waves.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文将纳赫兹引力波观测（NANOGrav等）与宇宙一阶相变、核塌缩超新星中微子信号及低质量跷跷板机制联系起来，提出可通过未来银河系超新星中微子观测和脉冲星计时阵列测量加以检验。主题与PTA方向高度相关，理论构想具体且给出可观测预言，值得点击阅读。
decision.title_zh: 回响于恒星终幕的宇宙序曲：纳赫兹引力波对核塌缩超新星中微子的启示
decision.abstract_zh: 来自NANOGrav及其他观测的、关于纳赫兹引力波日益增长的证据，可能指向在温度约为$\mathcal{O}(10-100)\;\mathrm{MeV}$处发生的一次宇宙学一阶相变。这样的解释需要在该能量范围内存在超出标准模型的动力学。若果真如此，那么很可能银河系核塌缩超新星爆炸会产生与一阶相变相关的关键组分，从而在塌缩最初几秒内发射的中微子能谱上留下可探测的印记。这可能为支持纳赫兹引力波信号的早期宇宙解释提供进一步证据。这里提出的情景也暗示了一种解释中微子质量的低质量跷跷板机制。我们概述了未来对银河系超新星的观测揭示该情景信号的前景，以及未来对原初纳赫兹引力波的脉冲星计时阵列测量所提供的进一步确证。
